scope: Current official TMLR venue audit and source-only adaptation needs; no proof verification, author certification, submission or experiment.
author_guide_requirements: Anonymous double-blind manuscript and supplement. Complete active OpenReview profiles for every author.
PDF generated with official TMLR style. No fixed page limit; length must be justified. Appendices follow references.
Supplement is author-created supporting PDF or ZIP, at most 100 MB, anonymized. Code/data improving reproducibility are encouraged.
Authors supply action-editor suggestions, IRB/human-subjects information, funding, competing interests and conflicts.
Submissions use CC BY 4.0 from submission onward, with author copyright retained. An identified preprint is permitted, but the anonymous submission must not link to it.
Broader-impact statement required where significant harm risk exists.

template_changes.action: Use documentclass[10pt]{article} and unmodified official tmlr style; remove twocolumn and geometry overrides. Default review mode; do not use accepted/preprint.
Anonymous author presentation; do not invent author names, affiliations or acceptance/publication metadata.

Use natbib author-year citations and alphabetized references. Embedded bibitems need compatible author-year labels. Template says consistent reference formatting is acceptable; official tmlr.bst is supplied for BibTeX.
Move table caption and label before tabular. Keep figure captions below figures.
Revise no-style-files claim after adopting official style. Disclose actual compilation/package mechanism.

editorial_policy_and_author_only_checks: No overlap in text, figures or results with another archival peer-reviewed paper already published, accepted or concurrently submitted. Non-archival work and preprints may overlap.
Every author must meet intellectual contribution, drafting/revision and responsibility criteria; final author list is fixed at submission.
All authors need sufficient annual quota. Current ordinary parameters N1=2,N9=9; reviewers/action editors receive doubled quotas. Existing submissions, including desk rejections, consume budget.
LLMs may assist but cannot be authors; humans retain full responsibility for correctness, originality and integrity.
No explicit blanket AI-tool disclosure clause was located in the current author LLM policy. Voluntary accurate disclosure is recommended, not represented as mandatory.
Formal TMLR certifications are editor-assigned after acceptance; internal AI checks are not journal certifications.
acceptance_and_positioning: Evidence must support claims; reducing unsupported claims is an expressly allowed remedy.
Reader interest and understandable findings matter. A new benchmark best result or a novel method is not mandatory.

The policy warns that fully AI-generated work with little or no human involvement is unlikely to communicate appropriately. This does not prohibit fully LLM annotation; annotation and author accountability are separate.
Inference: position this paper as a finite-horizon curation theory and negative model-calibration study, not an unfinished promise of empirical benefit.
specific_scientific_scope_preservation: Retain no natural-text utility, runtime or total-memory advantage claim; retain v3/v4 failures and no-retuning outcome.
Revise draft/checkpoint language into a completed bounded study; explicitly call downstream study unexecuted, not part of claimed evidence.
Preserve limitations and responsible-use discussion; a separate Broader impact heading can make risks of privacy assurances, retained metadata and LLM-label misuse easier to find.
A concise reproducibility statement should distinguish public aggregate/source replay from private observation/inference replay. Do not claim all observations are public.
Two uninspected full texts are an unresolved novelty-comparison limitation; no policy waives this. Narrow claims honestly rather than mark comparisons complete.
submission_blockers_not_certifiable_by_a: Final legal author list, complete OpenReview profiles, author consent and intellectual accountability.
Annual quota, prior archival publication and concurrent-submission status.
Accurate funding, conflicts, IRB/human-subjects and license attestations.

A rendered anonymous official-style PDF and a separate anonymous supplement. Existing public history package should not be uploaded unchanged because receipts/review reports can identify repository/user.
Actual external submission requires an explicit request; this audit does not submit.
boundary: Fully LLM annotation remains zero human annotation/review. This does not fabricate or waive TMLR human author responsibilities. No original empirical or human gate is marked passed.

changes: Replaced absolute source path with repository-relative path.
